title: Austin's Private Policy Talks
summary:
*   **Closed-Door Session Announced:** A special meeting was held with the sole public purpose of announcing that officials would immediately convene in a closed executive session.
*   **Confidential Business:** This private meeting was authorized under state law to discuss sensitive topics, typically involving matters like economic development negotiations, real estate transactions, or potential gifts.
*   **No Public Action Taken:** No public votes, new policies, or public hearings were conducted during this brief open session. Any subsequent decisions related to the private discussions would be addressed later.

CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Called Council Meeting
March 18, 1981
11:00 Α.Μ.
Council Chambers
301 West Second Street
The meeting was called to order with Mayor McClellan presiding. Roll Call: Present: Mayor
McClellan, Councilmembers Goodman, Himmelblau, Mayor Pro Tem Trevino, Councilmember Mullen
Councilmember Cooke
Absent:
Mayor McClellan opened the meeting scheduled for 11:00 A.M., stating that this was a
Special Called Meeting of the City Council for the purpose of publicly announcing that it
will convene in a closed or executive session authorized by Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f)
and (g) of Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated; and after such closed
or executive session any final action, decision or vote with regard to any matter
considered in the closed or executive session, should such action, decision or vote be
necessary.
Mayor McClellan announced that the Council would go into executive session at this time to
consider the items authorized in Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f) and (g) of Article
6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated.
ATTEST;
Grace Monise
City Clerk
